headline: Fishermans Row and LinnMercy Roil in Fresh Strongpoint Battles
war_summary: Since the preceding bulletin, Fishermans Row has become the liveliest front, logging eight strongpoint events in the latest two hours and eleven in the past day; the ledger still reads seven Wardens, one Colonial, and one position in no-man's-land. LinnMercy also continues hot, with six events in the last two hours and twenty in the past day, Wardens six and Colonials five. Weathered Expanse has slipped from its earlier two-hour peak but remains the war's busiest map by past-day count at fifty-four events; the line now stands four Wardens to five Colonials. Stlican Shelf has quieted after a heavy spell, recording nothing in the latest two hours although its past-day total reached forty-seven; Colonials hold six of nine positions, Wardens three. Stonecradle likewise has stilled since 02:55 after a past-day total of twenty-five events; Wardens five, Colonials four. Callahan's Passage still shows heavy casualties in the returns, but no strongpoint event has been recorded since 02:55; its past-day total is six. Godcrofts and DeadLands remain quiet.
